reply.acknowledgment: It is completely normal for a 7-year-old to push back when transitioning away from screens.
steps: Give a clear 5-minute and 2-minute warning before screen time ends so they can mentally prepare.
Use a visual timer so your child can physically see the time running out.
Offer a smooth transition activity right after, like a favorite snack or a quick game together.
reply.checkIn: Would you like to try one of these strategies this evening and see how it goes?
